title: Kids story - The Big Red Umbrella

parts.style: warm, gentle storytelling welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Hello, my friend. <short pause> Tonight's story is about a bear, a rainy day, and a big red umbrella.
Bruno was a big brown bear who lived at the edge of the forest. <short pause> He had a round tummy, a soft nose, and his very favorite thing in the whole world... <short pause> a big red umbrella.

parts.style: gentle, a soft smile in the voice, illustrating
parts.text: It was the biggest umbrella in the forest. <short pause> When Bruno held it over his head, he stayed dry from his ears all the way down to his toes. <short pause> And he loved to hear the rain go pitter, patter, on the top.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: One morning, the clouds rolled in, gray and heavy. <short pause> Pitter, patter, went the rain. <short pause> So Bruno opened his big red umbrella and set off down the path to visit the pond.

He hadn't gone far when he saw a little rabbit, shivering under a leaf. <short pause> Her ears were dripping wet. <short pause> Bruno stopped. <short pause> Would you like to come under my umbrella? he asked. <short pause> Oh, yes please, said the rabbit, and she hopped in close beside him.

A little farther on, they met a mouse, trying to stay dry inside an acorn cup. <short pause> It wasn't working very well. <short pause> There's room for one more, said Bruno. <short pause> And the mouse climbed up onto the rabbit's head, warm and dry.

parts.style: gentle, a soft smile in the voice, illustrating
parts.text: Then they met a hedgehog. <short pause> And a squirrel. <short pause> And a very small, very soggy bird. <short pause> Each time, Bruno said the same thing. <short pause> Come in. <short pause> There's room.

But now the umbrella was very crowded. <short pause> Everyone was squeezed together, nose to tail. <short pause> And Bruno's big furry back was sticking out in the rain, getting wetter and wetter. <short pause> Was he sad?

Not one bit. <short pause> Because under the umbrella, everyone was laughing and talking and telling stories. <short pause> Bruno had gone out by himself that morning... <short pause> and now he had six new friends.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: When they reached the pond, the rain stopped. <short pause> The sun peeked out, and a rainbow stretched across the sky. <short pause> And the little rabbit said, Bruno, you're all wet! <short pause> Let's dry you off. <short pause> So everyone snuggled around the big bear until his fur was warm and fluffy again.
From that day on, whenever it rained, Bruno's friends came to find him. <short pause> And whenever Bruno felt cold, or tired, or lonely, his friends were there for him, too.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Bruno learned something wonderful that day. <short pause> When you share what you have, even if it's not very much, it doesn't get smaller. <short pause> It gets bigger. <short pause> Because kindness always comes back around.
I wonder, my friend... <short pause> who could you share your umbrella with tomorrow?
That's the end of our story. <short pause> Goodnight, my friend.
